svg.text: BP in TSF (factored Strength I); e/emax and sliding as demand / capacity (≤ 1.0 passes).
Full tables: DH 4 to 40 ft in 2 ft steps, in the pilot file (design-tables.md).
1. Design values: B-504-A C. AASHTO simplified (extensible), coherent gravity (strips).
2. Rail anchor slab 185 psf, roadway HMA 140 psf, both as DW (1.50 / 0.65).
3. LS 2.0 ft (1.75), except under a backslope.
4. Core: moments about the base center. Truncated: all weight at the bottom's center (CDOT).
8. Backslope over a truncated base: per project [Decide DT5].
EQUATIONS: EXTERNAL STABILITY (tables E, per ft)
E1. Ka​ = tan2​(45° − φ/2); Coulomb Ka​ under a backslope, δ = β
E2. PEH​ = ½ γf​ Ka​ h2​, h = DH + L tan β
E3. PLS​ = γf​ heq​ Ka​ DH, heq​ = 2.0 ft (A-C Table 1)
E4. PDW​ = qDW​ Ka​ DH; VDW​ = qDW​ L
E5. Core: V = γEV​ γr​ DH L + γDW​ VDW​ (+ γLS​ γr​ heq​ L, bearing)
E6. Truncated: V = γEV​ γr​ (DH Lb​ + ½ s DH2​) + ..., all at the bottom's center
s = ¾ (soil), ½ (rock); Lb​ = bottom length (CDOT method)
E7. e = [γEH​ PEH​ h/3 + (γLS​ PLS​ + γDW​ PDW​) DH/2] / V ≤ L/3
E9. φτ​ V tan φmin​ ≥ γEH​ PEH​ cos β + γLS​ PLS​ + γDW​ PDW​
φτ​ = 1.0; γEV​ = 1.00, no live load; AASHTO 11.10.5.3
TABLE R: TOP LAYERS UNDER A BARRIER ON A MOMENT SLAB (Web Doc 326 9.2)
Tult per R3 (RF_ID 1.3, RF_CR 1.8 PP / 2.55 HDPE, RF_D 1.1); steel per R4. Equations R1 to R5 below.
4,800 lb/ft woven PP: TL-3 and TL-4 at 1 ft spacing; not at 2 ft (TL-4 needs about 5,500); TL-5 needs 4,800 to 6,500.
Barrier and moment slab on top; band h1 (2.25 ft TL-3/4, 1.6 ft TL-5) at pdy1, band h2 (2.5 ft) at pdy2;
each layer takes the pressure over the part of its tributary height inside each band (pd × At).
WORKED EXAMPLE (16 ft core wall, roadway, geogrid at 2 ft, layer at z = 15 ft)
From table I-B: σH = 0.900 ksf, P′ = 1.02 kip/ft per ft.
E7 to E9 (table E-B, DH 16): BP = 2.338 TSF; e/emax 0.682; sliding 0.615. OK.
EQUATIONS: BARRIER ON A MOMENT SLAB (table R)
R1. Fy​ = pdy​ At​ over band h1 (pdy1​) and h2 (pdy2​); Fpd​ = pdp​ At​; At​ = the layer's tributary height in the band (Web Doc 326 9.2)
R3. Geosynthetics: Tult​ ≥ (Fs​ RFCR​ + Fy​) RFID​ RFD​ / φ, φ = 1.0 (AASHTO Eq. 11.10.10.2-1)
R4. Steel: φ Tal​ Rc​ ≥ Fs​ + Fy​, φ = 1.0 strips, 0.85 grids (AASHTO 11.5.8)
R5. Pullout over the full length L: φ P′ L Rc​ ≥ Fs​ + Fpd​, φ = 1.0 geosynthetics, 1.20 steel (Web Doc 326 Eq. 9-6)
Seals, designer, detailer, checker, dates (standard block)
MSE and GRS Wall Design Tables: External Stability and Barrier
Replaces: H1 to H4, O1 to O4 (with B-504-H2)
Revised for AASHTO LRFD 10th and MASH
